spans.title: Six Inches High
spans.blurb: A man wakes flat on his back, unable to stir, every limb tied down. Then something alive, six inches tall, comes marching up his chest.

spans.title: Cigars in the Coal Scuttle
spans.blurb: A doctor shares rooms with a brilliant friend who keeps cigars in the coal scuttle, tobacco in a slipper, and does pistol practice indoors. A fond, exasperated portrait.

spans.title: Not Even for Ready Money
spans.blurb: An aunt arrives for tea expecting the cucumber sandwiches she was promised. There are none, not even for ready money, and the excuses are exquisite.

spans.title: The Handbag Interview
spans.blurb: A formidable mother interviews a hopeful suitor: income, politics, parents. His answers go beautifully until she asks who his people are, and he must mention a handbag.

books.pairNote: Two separate tea-time scenes with the same cast; the sandwich vignette and the interview stand apart without repeating or resolving each other.

spans.title: The Tenth of February
spans.blurb: At sunrise, gunfire wakes a frontier town. From inside a burning house, a mother watches neighbors fall and must walk out through the smoke with her children.

spans.title: Behind the Locked Door
spans.blurb: In the small hours a household wakes to alarming sounds behind a locked bedroom door. The doors will not give, and the lady inside is very ill.

spans.title: One Fish Short
spans.blurb: Two men and six sled dogs camp in the frozen dark. At feeding time Bill counts the animals that came for fish, and the number is wrong.

spans.title: Wolves at the Firelight
spans.blurb: Wolves shadow two men across the frozen dark, and each night the circle draws in. A doglike shape slides into the firelight, watching the dogs, not the men.

books.pairNote: The longer piece openly explains the riddle the short one turns on: a seventh animal that comes in at feeding time is the wolf pack's decoy.

spans.title: The Marksman in the Oak
spans.blurb: A rifle shot comes from an impossible direction. High in a ragged oak across the river, a marksman is hidden, and the men below must bring him down.

spans.title: Nothing, Please Sir
spans.blurb: A small boy perched on a trunk commits the crime of sneezing. His schoolmaster's response, in a public coffee room, says everything about the school ahead.

spans.title: The Schoolmaster Meets His Match
spans.blurb: A runaway boy is dragged back to be flogged before the whole school. The new young assistant sits at his desk, and something in his face is different.

books.pairNote: One is a coach-stop vignette, the other the schoolroom revolt weeks later; neither repeats or spoils the other's turn.

spans.title: Called to Account
spans.blurb: A stout, sleepy secret agent is summoned to the Embassy and dressed down by a new master who wants activity. The agent has one talent left to show.

spans.title: Abandon All Hope
spans.blurb: A traveler reads the dreadful inscription over a dark gateway, then passes through into starless air full of sighs, led by a guide who knows the way.

spans.title: Paolo and Francesca
spans.blurb: In a black wind that never rests, whirled spirits cry out. Two of them drift close, still together, and one tells how a shared book undid them.

books.pairNote: Two different stops on the same descent; the gateway and the lovers share nothing but the traveler.
